query:
SELECT 
  id,
  blueprintId,
  sectionType,
  sectionNumber,
  status,
  SUBSTRING(content, 1, 50) as content_preview
FROM manuscripts 
WHERE blueprintId = 510001
ORDER BY 
  CASE sectionType
    WHEN 'prologue' THEN 1
    WHEN 'copyright' THEN 2
    WHEN 'dedication' THEN 3
    WHEN 'chapter' THEN 4
    WHEN 'epilogue' THEN 5
    WHEN 'acknowledgements' THEN 6
    WHEN 'authorBio' THEN 7
    WHEN 'alsoBy' THEN 8
    WHEN 'newsletter' THEN 9
  END,
  sectionNumber;
